verdict.rationale: Formant is a cloud platform that stores fleet telemetry, so data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documented retention periods, retention policies, or data deletion controls. The ability to choose which streams are uploaded (formant-docs-37) and to rate-limit ingestion (formant-docs-31) are adjacent ingestion controls, not retention or deletion, so they earn no credit.
